recipe.visualDefinition: A six-panel grid composition featuring a central horizontal typographic bar. Each panel contains a portrait of the same subject in various expressive poses, set against a dark blue vignetted studio backdrop. The subject wears a high-contrast blue and gold sequined outfit.
coreVisualRelationships: Repetition of subject across six distinct frames
Central horizontal band bisecting the grid for primary text
Contrast between the matte blue background and reflective gold sequins
Integration of secondary text within the negative space of a primary letterform
coreInvariants: Dark blue vignetted background in all photo panels
Consistent lighting and costume across all portraits
Geometric sans-serif typography as the central anchor

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Six medium-shot portraits arranged in two rows of three, with the middle row replaced by a text banner.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, central geometric 'O' which houses the secondary text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Z-pattern scanning from top-left portrait to bottom-right, interrupted by the high-contrast central text bar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy vignetting creates dark corners in each frame, focusing attention on the subject's face and chest.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep cobalt blue (background and text bar)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the blues and yellows, with high value highlights on the metallic textures.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to blue, gold, white, and skin tones

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'O' is scaled to act as a frame for secondary information

composition.relationshipToImage: Overlays a solid blue bar separating the photo rows

composition.position: Inside the counter of the display 'O'

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Super-family pairing using a wide geometric for display and a condensed version for nested details.

candidateDirections.reason: Perfect geometric circles and 1970s/80s historical accuracy.
Classic geometric proportions and sharp terminals.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a 3x2 grid of portraits. The top row has 3 photos, the bottom row has 3 photos. Leave a solid blue horizontal bar across the middle. Each photo should feature a man with an afro and mustache in a blue and gold sequined disco outfit, posing differently against a dark blue vignetted studio background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large gold geometric sans-serif text across the blue bar. Place smaller white stacked sans-serif text inside the circular opening of the central letter 'O'.

verificationChecks: Is the central bar a solid, flat blue?
Does the gold of the text match the gold of the sequins?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact wording of the original title
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is perfectly centered in the horizontal bar
Verify the secondary text is legible within the 'O'
Confirm the sequin texture looks metallic and reflective
recipe.reuseFormula: Grid of [Subject] + [Vignetted Studio Background] + [Central Horizontal Color Bar] + [Geometric Sans-Serif Display Type] + [Nested Subtitle Type]
